# CONTACT

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - value record.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

One service/account pair from a user's read-only contact list.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#notes-and-contacts).

Fields are writable on the local value; modifying a copy does not write back to the board.

## Account

`CONTACT.Account: STRING`

Writable field.

Account name or address on this contact's service.

## Service

`CONTACT.Service: STRING`

Writable field.

Name of the contact service, such as email, web, IRC or another configured service.
